description: Ask for a right to be given to an account or to the members of a space. It stays PENDING and does nothing until the owner (who holds the right) approves it as a person on https://ce-net.com/mcp; or at once if the owner proposed it with their own AI and turned on auto-approve. Joining a space gives talking only; every other right goes through here.

owner.description: account scope: who grants it (default you); they must hold the right and share a space with you

reason.description: why, in a sentence (shown to the owner)

scope.description: account (default): one account; space: everyone in the space when approved, while they stay members

space.description: a space to post the request and the answer in (default: the space of a space scope)

to.description: a 16-hex account id, or a space id when scope is space

name: permission_propose
title: Propose a permission (the owner approves it)
